E1.value: Next unlock 2026-12-08 (22 days): 91,770,833 SXT (Investors 39.2%, Insiders 33.9%, Foundation rest). Circulating per §1: CoinGecko 4,646,994,974 is contradicted on-chain (19 project Gnosis Safes in Ethereum top-50 hold 1,203.0M, so CG's implied 353M non-circulating is impossible). On-chain circulating <= 5,000M - 1,203M = 3,797M -> 2.42%; tokenomics.com schedule circulating 2,598.8M -> 3.53%. Fails on both on-chain bases. (CoinGecko basis would be 1.975%, not used per §1.)

E2.value: Not computed precisely. Six monthly ~92-107M unlocks to 2027-05 (~0.55-0.64B) = ~15-17% of 3.797B or ~21-25% of 2.599B, plus staking rewards; likely fail on schedule basis.

E3.value: 2,598.8M/5,000M = 52.0% (tokenomics.com) up to 3,797M/5,000M = 75.9% (on-chain upper bound); >=30% on either basis.

E4.value: Schedule published: 30 remaining monthly events (8th of month) releasing 2,686,041,657 SXT to 2029-05-08. Note: custody is discretionary multisig Safes, not on-chain vesting contracts.
